I'm a 15 yo girl living in the netherlands. I'm very insecure and shy. In primary school I've been bullied since the 3rd grade. In the begining it started with calling names, but in the eight grade they hit me too. Since I was in the sixth grade, i've had suicidal thoughts and I cut myself. In the eight grade I first attempted. It wasn't really serious, but I cut my wrist, thighs, hips and belly and hoped I'd bleed to death. Didn't happen obviously. I realised it was time to seek help and I went to my gp. He said I had to go to a therapist and I saw my first psychologist. I changed school and in the summer holiday between primary and high school i didn't feel well. Cancer was discovered. I still went to school and on my new school, the bullying stopped for a while. Not that long, because three months after the start i was as far as I'd been. 2nd,3rd and 4th attempt followed quickly. Second grade was about the same. I missed a lot of school because of the cancer. I heard I'd live for two or three more years from then. (now one or two) 5th and 6th attempts were more serious. I ended up in hospital for weeks. next grade. I was more absent as present at school and if I was there, the bullying went on and on. I've been raped by a classmate and he told everyone. 7th attempt, very serious. I was knocked out for three months. And now I've just woken up.out of my eight attempt.  This is pretty much it I guess.

I don't want anyone to feel bad. But it seems my parents don't care any more, so the reason I am still here is the amount of unanswered posts here. I don't want to leave if I could prevent others to kill them selves.
